name: dufs
description: Browse, preview, upload and download files on your dufs servers - several servers, one switcher

provides.description: Open a file or folder on one of your dufs servers in Dufs: its folder, with the file selected and previewed.

params.name: url
params.description: The file's or folder's address on a dufs server Dufs knows, e.g. http://pi5.lan:5000/docs/notes.md (a folder ends with /).
